title: Specified lesser violations.
officialText:
The commissioner shall classify the following violations as lesser violations:

1.A violation of item 5 of section 1111.1, of section 1111.2, or of item 7 of section 1111.3 of the New York city building code, or a violation of section 28-313.1, 28-313.2 or 28-313.3 of the administrative code of the city of New York.

(Am. L.L. L.L. 2019/122, 6/29/2019, eff. 1/1/2020; Am. L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)
